intro.title: Two plans. One is free.
intro.lede: Check your own CV against the jobs you want, and practice the interview out loud with an AI interviewer. Pay only when you want more interviews.

pack.body: You buy it while Pro is active. The interviews never expire, and they still work after Pro ends.
